required_outcomes: Records the outcome: the landlord consented in writing ('Yes this is fine') to the tenant installing her own machine on the terms in the 27 July email; the new machine is the tenant's property, not part of the inventory, and leaves with her; the landlord's LG is going to the tip with the tenant's brother at no charge.
Closes the request without payment (no contractor, no invoice), or sets a short dated follow-up to confirm the swap has happened and then closes.
Confirms the agreed terms in writing to the tenant and tells the landlord how the old machine is being disposed of, so both have the same record.
acceptable_alternatives: Keeping the request open with a dated follow-up to confirm the new machine is in and the old one gone, then closing without payment.
Recording the landlord's decision as tenant_self_fix rather than approved, as long as the ownership terms are recorded.
positive_behaviours: Mentions the practical safety point if the tenant's brother connects the machine (power off, water isolated, no extension leads).
Suggests the inventory is updated to show the LG removed and the new machine as the tenant's.
red_flags: Raising a removal charge or seeking a payment for this request.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a contractor or booking a visit for removal or installation.
Recording an invoice or payment on this request.
critical_failures: Leaving the case without recording the ownership terms anywhere (no note, no written confirmation to either party), so the agreement can be disputed at check-out.
